sources.snippet: LIBERO Benchmarking Knowledge Transfer in Lifelong Robot Learning In the future, robots will be pretrained with a diverse set of skills in factory before deployment. However, we believe it is also a must for them to learn with their human users throughout their lifetime to really become a personalized embodied agent.
